about_the_game:
Line up patterned blocks to build as many pyramids as you can, then crush them all at once to convert them into points! Pyramis is an arcade puzzle game that will have you matching colors, filling in space, and making chains in entirely new ways.

Designed for puzzle fans first and foremost, Pyramis is a challenging game, and the best strategies demand skill and close attention. For first time players, building a pyramid can be a challenge itself, but beyond that, the pyramids you build can be extended, rotated, overlapped, intersected, chained, and recursive!

In Arcade mode, the goal is to earn the highest score you can and survive as long as possible while the game continually gets faster.

Additional modes will be added as development continues!
